E1.binding_rule: Freeze a separate adopted pilot binding manifest with registration hash and exact role/case/control assignment facts BEFORE candidate B execution starts. Null/empty bindings remain pending; mismatches reject. Pre-candidate reference-only A/AA evidence is disclosed and cannot retroactively qualify old candidates. Role source differences must be separately pinned.
E1.recovery_rule: Same-mode continuous vs split/resume at a saved boundary: native load boundary MUST be bitwise exact for FP32 master/model/Adam/BN/RNG and discrete state. Post-resume continuation retains strict failures and uses the same prospective tier budget.
E1.same_input_rule: All 8 ranks, complete parameter gradients, no parameter/rank sampling. GPU ranks are NOT independent AA replicates.

E2.claim: Execution preservation within a NEW prospectively fixed AA-relative pilot budget; not bitwise optimizer equivalence or a proof of lossless long training.

engineering_fast.reason: P0 common-computation hoisting retains the observed same-input exact path. Native gradients and continued BN remain separately assessed.

module_tolerances.scope: Complete Bt/q_final/total loss and all registered diagnostic/task-loss modules on every rank; both A_B and AA_B.

engineering_timevec.reason: B*T batching/einsum changes FP32 reduction order. These are NEW fixed forward criteria, not revisions to the old bitwise full validator. Absolute physical trajectory bound prevents normalized-scale ambiguity. No AB timevec result was available when these criteria were written.

E2.native_continuation_BN: Float BN values may drift after different native CUDA gradients. E2 same-input BN_float exact is NOT a claim of long-continuation BN bitwise equivalence. Native checkpoint old strict failures remain; dtype/counter/mode/population stay E1 exact.
E2.old_full_validator: Original q0/q_final bitwise, original module and gradient strict results stay unchanged; timevec can fail old strict and remain only an independent pilot candidate.

bootstrap.family: 2 groups x 2 variants x 2 references x 3 guard metrics x max 2 prospectively registered candidates
bootstrap.weighting: Pooled sampled log sums divided by sampled scene counts

dev.full_canonical_gate: No sampled dev proxy can satisfy completion; all 1696 rows, all 16 logs and both variants mandatory.
dev.inconclusive: A mean within margin but CI below margin remains pending; a mean below margin rejects. No widening margins after seeing receipts. Only 16 logs, one training seed; no long-run or Navtest claim.
dev.rule: At +500 BOTH q0 and q_final B-A and B-AA mean deltas AND simultaneous one-sided log-bootstrap lower bounds must be >= -margin for PDMS/NC/TTC. ALL rows must be finite/ok and independently match exact 1696 token/log index; summaries must match CSV means. q_final-q0 gain is diagnostic, cannot hide either variant regression.

numeric.AA_control_policy: Fresh AA must meet the tier absolute ceiling too. An unstable control cannot grant acceptance to an unstable candidate.
numeric.quantiles: Report per logical tensor max-absolute p50/p90/p99 and worst tensors unchanged; heterogeneous tensor units prevent pooling raw max-absolute into one replacement tolerance.

stage_drift.E3: Report same drift trajectory; apply E3 absolute ceilings at EVERY registered boundary, do not label precision drift as E2 non-amplification.
stage_drift.metric: A_B relative_L2 / (A_A relative_L2 + E2 registered floor)

numeric.zero_norm_policy: If reference norm or update norm is zero, require ALL compared values/updates zero; no epsilon-denominator acceptance.

trial_plan.limits: One 500-step triplet per mid origin is a bounded pilot, not a statistical proof over training seeds. Frozen native reference, replay and candidate consume identical ordered batches.
trial_plan.optional_extension_1000: Separate prospective amendment/manual review; never automatic and never revise thresholds after seeing the candidate.
